DJ Face takes over The Craic this Wednesday from 8 PM to midnight.

Everyone's back in town. Pull up a chair, find your people, and stay a while. Kick off the holiday weekend with a pint and a proper Thanksgiving Eve soundtrack.

Follow the artist: @thefaceshow

Caleb Davis plays The Craic this Sunday from 7:30 PM to 10:30 PM.

A Sunday night set to close out the weekend right. Grab a pint, settle in, and let the music carry your evening.

Follow the artist: @calebdavismusic

Zach Fowler is back at The Craic this Friday from 7:30 PM to 10:30 PM.

His third night with us this season. Grab a pint, settle in, and let the music carry your Friday night.

Follow the artist: @prophet_of_positivity
